install.//: The repo's pnpm workspace install, which the suite is a member of, plus the one browser the suite uses. Quartz Core installs separately (site-v5:install).

e2e.//: Build every cgc-* plugin and the fixture site (twice: with and without them), then run the suite. Narrow it with --args, e.g. --args="../plugins/cgc-tags -g colour". See docs/adr/0004.

acceptance.//: The real-site acceptance report, the suite's second seam (CONTEXT.md): build content/public under v4 (dist/public) and v5 (quartz-v5/core/public), then print every difference in URLs, sitemap and RSS membership and head metadata, plus site-styles' cascade-layer guard on the v5 build (needs the install target's Chromium). Exits 1 while any difference is off the allowlist (acceptance/allowlist.mjs), 2 when it cannot run, and 3 when it would pass but the case redirects went unchecked on a case-insensitive filesystem (pass --allow-unverified-redirects on a local macOS run). Writes dist/acceptance/report.{txt,json}. Compare existing builds with --skip-build, or others with --v4/--v5/--vault <dir> (relative paths are read from the repo root, like the defaults); print every difference with --full. Never run it beside the e2e suite in the same checkout: they share Quartz Core's transpile cache.
